description: This file defines the SugarSession class, which manages user session handling within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods to start, destroy, and access session data, encapsulating session management logic.

classes.name: SugarSession
classes.description: A class providing session management functionalities such as starting, destroying, and accessing session data in the CRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SugarSession object; checks if session_id() already exists.

methods.name: setSessionId
methods.description: Sets the session ID to the provided value.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a session if none exists, and assigns the session ID.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Implements singleton pattern to get the single instance of SugarSession.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys all session variables and terminates the session.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Prevents cloning of the singleton instance.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Sets a session variable to a value.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the session writing upon object destruction.
